about: Re-simulated Thursday Oct 1 (midday ET) with Wednesday's practice reports, tonight's Steelers–Browns final statuses and the week's news. Players listed as out are removed and 72% of their carries and targets go to teammates at their position, split by what each has done this season. Flags mark news the model still can't price: players who might not play, and Friday game statuses that aren't out yet.
bar: Re-simulated Oct 1 with the injury news. Friday statuses (Jefferson, Eagles) are still to come.

Justin Jefferson.n: Ankle sprain, missed Wednesday, day-to-day. Built with him playing at a trimmed share. Friday's game status isn't out yet; if he sits, his picks are void and Jordan Addison is the No. 1.

Jordan Addison.n: Becomes the No. 1 receiver if Jefferson sits. This build has Jefferson playing.

DeVonta Smith.n: Hamstring, missed Wednesday. Built with him playing: he took the same practice path last week and played. Final status comes Friday.

Will Shipley.n: Foot, missed Wednesday; played last week. Built with him playing.

Chris Godwin Jr..n: New ankle injury, missed Wednesday. Built with him playing, with rookie Jalon Daniels at QB.

Jalen Coker.n: Quad, missed Wednesday and is probably out. Built with him playing.

Xavier Legette.n: Knee, missed Wednesday. Built with him playing.

Keon Coleman.n: Ankle, missed Wednesday. Built with him playing.

Caleb Douglas.n: Ankle, missed Wednesday after sitting out Week 3. Built with him playing.

Colby Parkinson.n: Knee/shoulder, missed Wednesday. Built with him playing.

Charlie Kolar.n: Forearm, missed Wednesday. Built with him playing.

Brenen Thompson.n: Quad, missed Wednesday. Built with him playing.

Rachaad White.n: Shoulder, the only Commander in London who didn't practice Wednesday. Built with him playing; Jacory Croskey-Merritt gets more if he sits.

Austin Ekeler.n: Signed this week and may be active if Rachaad White can't go.

Tony Pollard.n: Foot, missed Wednesday but played through it last week. Built with him playing.

Tyjae Spears.n: Ankle, missed Wednesday but played through it last week. Built with him playing.

Mike Evans.n: Rib, missed Wednesday. Reported day-to-day and not expected to miss time.

Lamar Jackson.n: Limited Wednesday (back); expected to play. The model has him at full strength.

Puka Nacua.n: Back after missing two games (hip/groin), limited Wednesday. Modeled at his usual share; a snap limit would make his numbers high.

Nico Collins.n: Back after missing two games, limited Wednesday. Modeled at his usual share; a snap limit would make his numbers high.

Kene Nwangwu.n: No offensive snaps this season. His share comes mostly from the model's running-back average, so treat his number as high. Braelon Allen is the lead back, with Isaiah Davis mixed in.

2026w4-mia-min-ml-min.n: Built with Jefferson playing. His Friday status isn't out; MIN stays a big favorite either way.

2026w4-mia-min-ats-min.n: Built with Jefferson playing. If he sits, this is weaker than shown.

2026w4-ten-bal-ml-bal.n: Lamar Jackson limited (back) but expected to play. BAL lost both centers (Gwyn, Pocic) long-term, which season blocking stats don't show yet.

2026w4-ten-bal-td-derrick-henry.n: BAL lost both centers (Gwyn, Pocic) long-term: a small knock on short-yardage runs the model can't see yet.

2026w4-la-phi-ats-phi.n: Built with Goedert and Hollywood Brown out, Smith and Shipley playing, and Puka Nacua back. Eagles' final statuses come Friday; if Smith sits, this is weaker.

2026w4-la-phi-ml-phi.n: Same as PHI +3: built with Smith playing and Goedert/Brown out. Final statuses Friday.

2026w4-la-phi-tot-over.n: Built with Smith playing and Puka Nacua back. Final Eagles statuses come Friday.

2026w4-pit-cle-recYds-harold-fannin-jr-2.n: Joey Porter Jr. (out) is in this build. CBs Jalen Ramsey (wrist) and Brandin Echols (concussion) are questionable, which isn't.

2026w4-gb-tb-ats-tb.n: Built with Jalon Daniels starting. The model has this a pick'em while the market moved to GB -3.5; the model rates an unknown rookie QB only a little below average.

pit-cle: Final statuses: PIT RB Rico Dowdle and CB Joey Porter Jr. out (both in this build); CBs Jalen Ramsey (wrist) and Brandin Echols (concussion) questionable.
CLE is out C Elgton Jenkins and WR Tylan Wallace; G Teven Jenkins is limited. Two interior line starters may be missing.
ind-was: Mariota starts again for WAS (in the model). Jayden Daniels was limited.
WAS RB Rachaad White (shoulder) didn't practice Wednesday; Austin Ekeler signed. S Nick Cross (illness, out; in this build) and G Sam Cosmi (out) are ruled out.
ten-bal: Lamar Jackson limited (back), expected to play. Zay Flowers (hamstring) is back at limited practice and is in this build; the Sep 30 build had him out.
BAL lost centers Jovaughn Gwyn and Ethan Pocic long-term. TEN RBs Tony Pollard and Tyjae Spears missed Wednesday but played hurt last week.
ne-buf: DJ Moore limited (shoulder), expected to play. Keon Coleman missed practice.
NE CB Christian Gonzalez and RT Morgan Moses missed Wednesday; Drake Maye was a full participant.
nyj-chi: Caleb Williams out; Case Keenum starts in this build (not officially named).
NYJ without Breece Hall, Adonai Mitchell and TE Mason Taylor. Braelon Allen leads the backfield and Garrett Wilson's target share jumps to about 37%.
jax-cin: Jakobi Meyers limited (thumb) as usual. JAX RB LeQuint Allen Jr. limited (hip).
CIN S Kyle Dugger and DT B.J. Hill missed Wednesday.
dal-hou: Nico Collins is back (limited Wednesday, expected to play) and in this build. The Sep 30 build had him out.
la-phi: LA gets Puka Nacua back (in this build); TE Terrance Ferguson is out. Davante Adams' Wednesday DNP was a rest day.
PHI: Goedert and Hollywood Brown are out in this build, Smith and Shipley playing. All four missed Wednesday; final statuses come Friday.
gb-tb: Baker Mayfield (dislocated thumb) is out about three weeks; undrafted rookie Jalon Daniels starts. The model now has this a pick'em (TB 54% before); the market moved to GB -3.5 and the total to 38.5.
GB's Jayden Reed is out for the season (neck surgery); his targets go to Golden and Watson. Chris Godwin Jr. (ankle) missed Wednesday.
mia-min: Justin Jefferson (ankle) missed Wednesday and is day-to-day; this build has him playing.
MIA lost De'Von Achane for the season; Ollie Gordon II leads, with Jaylen Wright in a smaller role.
kc-lv: Nothing material: Mahomes and Ashton Jeanty practiced fully. Brock Bowers is no longer on the report.
lac-sea: LAC missed six on Wednesday, including CB Donte Jackson (concussion) and TE Charlie Kolar. Derwin James and Ladd McConkey were limited.
den-sf: Mike Evans (rib) missed Wednesday but isn't expected to miss time. Christian McCaffrey's DNP was his usual rest day.
det-car: CAR placed CBs Jaycee Horn and Mike Jackson on IR (in this build's matchups). WRs Jalen Coker and Xavier Legette missed practice; Bryce Young was full. Chuba Hubbard and Darren Waller sat Wednesday for rest.
atl-no: NO RB Travis Etienne is out for multiple weeks; Alvin Kamara starts. The spread moved to ATL +2.5, which this build uses.
ari-nyg: NYG RB Tyrone Tracy Jr. and LT Andrew Thomas missed Wednesday.
